verdict.rationale: Pylon is a support platform with AI support agents, so a voice or phone agent is a fair axis. Its documented channels are Slack Connect, Email, Microsoft Teams, Chat Widget and Forms, with no phone or voice channel for the agent. The only call-related item is AI task generation after a customer call, which is an adjacent feature and not a speech-in, speech-out agent.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat
